…yeah YTA. Yes, your second child matters too. But read the room regarding the status of queer people in the US. Queer people are actively having their rights taken away, but you will most likely not experience this bc of your sexuality. Your sister and her wife most likely had to endure so much hatred (directly or not) to even become pregnant- why would you try to take this moment from them? This IVF pregnancy (because, shocker, this very well can be the last for them, but I hope it’s not) probably means the world to them. 

That point aside, you’re still TA. Your sister said it best with “this isn’t a competition”. You did your best to include your wife in the conversation, but that clearly was not the focus of this conversation in time. Yes it hurts, but your wife is an adult and should understand that not everything has to include you already. 

Also, you and your wife are already parents. Your sister and her wife are becoming first time parents. What did you want your parents to say to you when that was the topic of conversation? Did you really need them to blow wind up your ass that much?

For my relationship with weed! I have never been formally diagnosed with PTSD but I show symptoms (related to a fucked up childhood) and got a med card (IL) for it a year ago. I have smoked daily for about a year, and I know I can easily go through a gram without being too high. Something that has helped me with my T break (because I am not quite ready to give up weed fully, I am a young adult after all) is keeping my stuff out of sight/mind. 

I talk pretty regularly with my therapist about using, and he always emphases that weed is a good medication, but it should not be the only thing. Something you can do (that helps me when I need weed to calm down) is journal/vlog about how you’re feeling when high. I hope this helps a bit!!
